title: TrustOperationManifestV1
description: Metaschema for tests/fixtures/trust_operation_v1/manifest.json itself. Added per the #1715 review's point 6 ('add a manifest schema, metaschema validation'). A row claiming transformation_understanding=supported MUST carry a plan_ref pointing at a real plan fixture under tests/fixtures/trust_operation_v1/plans/valid/ (cross-file existence and consistency is checked by tests/trust_operation_v1_contract.rs, not by this schema alone).

config_bounds.description: The exact, already-configured limits a row MUST reference instead of inventing its own (the #1715 review's point 6 finding: the old T030 invented '4096' against unconfigured 1000/5000/10000). These mirror src/safety/mod.rs SafetyConfig::{strict,moderate,permissive}.max_command_length and src/safety/segments.rs::MAX_DEPTH, read directly at the time this manifest was frozen.

input_construction.description: Used instead of a literal 'input' string when the exact bytes are deterministically constructed (e.g. padding a base row to an exact configured length boundary) rather than hand-typed. Must be FULLY specified: tests/trust_operation_v1_contract.rs actually runs the construction and asserts the resulting bytes' exact length and sha256 against expected_length/expected_sha256 below, rather than trusting the row's own claim (#1715 revision-2 review point 5).

plan_ref.description: Null unless transformation_understanding=supported, in which case it must name a real plan fixture path under tests/fixtures/trust_operation_v1/plans/valid/.

verdict_floor_note.description: For a row whose mutation_detection/transformation_understanding is not_detected/unsupported due to an out-of-scope shell or form (e.g. T025's fish shell): documents that the EXISTING safety validator's own pattern-based risk assessment is unrelated to this contract and is never downgraded by a trust-operation not_detected/unsupported result. Fail-closed is preserved at the safety-validator layer regardless of what this contract can or cannot assess.

context_provenance.description: For a row that depends on context outside the command text (e.g. T022's symlink mapping): supplied_fixture means the mapping is injected ONLY for this test fixture; unobserved means a real run would have no such mapping and must not invent one.

allOf.$comment: EXACTLY ONE of input (literal) or input_construction (fully-specified constructor) per row (#1715 revision-2 review point 5).

The mode/entrypoint table's non-relaxable confirmation requirement, pinned at the manifest level: identified/possible mutations always require scoped human confirmation; not_detected never does (there is nothing identified to confirm).
